note:
METHOD (about 75 tool calls, 3 WebSearch, 3 WebFetch). One background script with three threads, every request through scripts/chamber/fetch_throttled.py, worked through the 77 composers: MusicBrainz (artist match on name and dates, then work?artist=<mbid>&inc=recording-rels), Deezer (album and track search on the name) and Apple's composerTerm song search for every composer without a chamber-titled Deezer hit. A second Apple pass covered the 16 composers whose first Apple search my script had skipped because Deezer showed a chamber-sounding title (duos, sonatas, symphonies): that shortcut was a mistake and found Bochsa, Böck and the Asplmayr trios. No lookup failed (no FetchError anywhere). The harness killed the first run of the script after 154 s (exit 144); it is resumable and was restarted under another name. Hits were confirmed with Deezer and Apple track lists, IMSLP api.php and three web searches (Abela, Anna Amalia, Bortniansky).
RESULT: recordings of in-scope chamber works turned up for 13 of the 77 composers (81 works kept): Brunetti (47), André (6), Barbella (6), Asplmayr (7), Balbastre (4), Abela (2), Agus (2), Bortniansky (2) and one each for Antes, Anna Amalia of Brunswick-Wolfenbüttel, Bochsa (the father), Böck and Brandl. Of the other 64, 62 are 'none found', Bevilacqua is out of scope by scoring and Benincori is partial; for many only duos, solo sonatas, orchestral or vocal works exist (Amon, Bréval, Bruni, Berbiguier, Fodor, Auber, Adam ...); I counted duos as none. 'None found' is weak for common names (Adam, Arnold, Bauer, Berg, Bowie, Brand, Braun, Bury, Albanese ...) and for Bauerschmidt, Bury and Angkistro, whose first names IMSLP does not give.
ADDED, NOT ON IMSLP (32), from discs I opened: Brunetti's string quartets (18: Concerto 1700, Carmen Veneris, Cuarteto Trifolium, Schuppanzigh-Quartett), six trios for two violins and bass L. 109-114 (Exordium Musicae, SEdeM) and six bassoon quintets Op. 2 (Tactus); André's Piano Trio Op. 17 (eda records); Bortniansky's Quintet in C major (it has an IMSLP page outside the census candidates: gap = true). Brunetti's 15 string-trio divertimenti are matched to IMSLP's collection page '23 Divertissements' by scoring and count only (the page lists no L. numbers). Brunetti's L. numbers are the discs'; the CPO disc is cited with MusicBrainz's BruWV numbers; the opus numbers in the titles are only those the discs give (Op. 3 No. 6, Op. 2 Nos. 1, 3, 4; the other Op. 3 quartets carry the opus in the set only).
WHERE THE BRIEF OR DATA FAILED: (1) Deezer's surname search is swamped by namesakes and foreign words (Antes), and Apple's composerTerm search is fuzzy: it also returns other composers' tracks from the same album, so an attribution needs a second source (Anna Amalia's Divertimento: confirmed on AllMusic/Radio Swiss Classic). (2) The brief does not say whether duos or sonatas with piano count as 'something turned up'; I counted them as none. (3) A print that names flutes first and violins as an alternative (Bevilacqua Op. 47: 2 flutes or 2 violins and guitar, recorded by Guitart 2023) has no string part in its first scoring; the census derived violins. I left it out as 'out of scope'. (4) Collection pages without keys or numbers (Brunetti 23 Divertissements, Böck Op. 6) cannot be matched reliably to a recording's numbering.
SCOPE CALLS FOR THE OWNER: Böck's Op. 6 (2 horns and bass) is kept as one set at medium confidence: four pieces are on Pan Classics (double bass instead of cello), all ten only on the editor's own label (I Ching Music), which does not count alone. Low confidence, drop if unwanted: Asplmayr's Trio moderne No. 1 (Catacoustic Consort's own label, pardessus de viole), Abela's F-major piece (the booklet does not say which manuscript is which 'Concerto armónico'), Bortniansky's Sinfonia Concertante (a septet; the Czech 'Russian Album' disc plays it with the Moscow Chamber Orchestra). Self-released mandolin singles (Have Mandolin Will Travel: Bevilacqua Op. 47, Böcklin Op. 30) were ignored. The Agus's author dates come from MusicBrainz (1749-1798); Böck's are unknown.
OPEN PROBLEMS: Benincori: Trio Arté (Gamma Musica 2014) record a three-movement G-minor trio (id IAB1) that could not be matched to an IMSLP page or a scoring, so no entry. Brunetti: further Carmen Veneris/Brilliant volumes may hold more trios and quartets, and the divertimenti L. 134, 135, 137-139, 141, 143, 144 are not on Deezer. Bruni's, Amon's and Bréval's quartets and trios, and Baillot's, are not recorded as far as MusicBrainz, Deezer and Apple show, but small-label discs may be missing. BY HAND (orchestrating session, 2026-10-17, on the owner's instruction to leave off lesser-known works that raise flags): 3 work(s) the agent kept at low confidence were moved to skipped (reason "doubtful") and parked in data/chamber/curation/parked-low-confidence.json: Bortniansky: Sinfonia Concertante in B-flat major; Abela: Armonia in F major; Asplmayr: Trio moderne No. 1, Op. 3.
